mapper.insert: INSERT INTO #{schema}.ecos_scenario_execution (id, scenario_id, run_type, run_mode, is_degraded, diagnosis_result_json, forecast_result_json, simulation_result_json, strategy_result_json, decision_record_id, trace_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_deleted, version_no, domain) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.scenarioId}, #{row.runType}, #{row.runMode}, FALSE, #{row.diagnosisResultJson}, #{row.forecastResultJson}, #{row.simulationResultJson}, #{row.strategyResultJson}, #{row.decisionRecordId}, #{row.traceId}, #{row.createBy}, NOW(), #{row.updateBy}, NOW(), 0, 0, #{row.domain})
mapper.select: SELECT id, scenario_id, run_type, run_mode, is_degraded, decision_record_id, trace_id, create_time FROM #{schema}.ecos_scenario_execution WHERE scenario_id = #{scenarioId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM #{schema}.ecos_scenario_execution WHERE scenario_id = #{scenarioId} AND run_mode = 'FORMAL' AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT run_mode FROM #{schema}.ecos_scenario_execution WHERE id = #{runId} AND is_deleted = 0
